title: Broncos seem to be nervous about a potential Drew Brees tampering case

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos seem to be nervous about a potential Drew Brees tampering case
sources.description: On Monday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reported that the Broncos talked to quarterback Drew Brees about joining the team for the AFC Championship, without acknowledging that Brees's status on the Saints' reserve-retired list made the move impossible.
